## Overview

The Action Picture Test (Renfrew 1997) is an expressive-language measure that the project's causal diagram already treats as a direct outcome of randomised assignment (`IG -> {EI, EG}`), but which had no confirmed test ceiling until the manual maxima were supplied on 2026-08-18 — Grammar 37, Information 40. Until then it sat under "Deferred / follow-ups" in the ITT suite design note, and no Bayesian estimate existed for either scale.

Grammar is scored in whole marks out of 37, so it needs no rescaling and carries none of the half-mark encoding caveats that apply to Information.

LRPDID015 models the time 1–3 outcome levels with a saturated arm-by-wave structure and a child
random intercept. `tau_t2` is the clean randomised t2 contrast and is the quantity to set beside
the matching ITT fit; `arm_gap_t1` is a baseline-balance quantity, and `arm_gap_t3` is a
**different randomised contrast** — assignment to the early-start rather than the delayed-start
treatment schedule, because by t3 both arms have been taught — with the derived crossover contrast
the change between those two randomised regime contrasts, not an identified catch-up. The model does not condition on the treatment-affected t2 score, and the child random
intercept partially pools stable heterogeneity rather than making each child their own control.

## Model

Bounded t1/t2/t3 levels are fitted jointly with separate immediate-minus-waitlist gaps at each
wave, a Beta-Binomial likelihood with $N = 37$, linear age, and a child random intercept.
Priors follow the shared template in `priors.py`.
